correctness.rationale: From actual RESULT.md, use odds u=p1/(1−p1), v=p2/(1−p2), f=(1,u+v,uv)/[(1+u)(1+v)]. Direct differentiation of P_q yields (∂v log P_q)/q=(Φ_{q−1}−1)/[(1+v)(1+(u+v)^q+(uv)^q)]. Independent central differences verified 54 cases. Φ_r=(1−u)(u+v)^r+u(uv)^r is convex in r, Φ_0=1, Φ_1≤1, weighted AM–GM gives Φ′_0≤0. Thus Φ_r≤1 for r∈[0,1], Φ_r≥1 for −1<r<0, with entropy factor signs reversed at one. Symmetry handles either coordinate; continuous limit handles parameter-zero, support sizes q=0. Published Shannon q=1 and n2 counterexample for every q>2 correctly cited. Finite grid is not proof of all q; convexity argument is.
